This small plot has my perennial crop — likely my enset and maybe a few fruit trees — and I take care of it myself with my family. I don't put chemical fertilizer on it; I save that money for the cereal plots where it makes a bigger difference. What I do is carry manure from our animals and household compost to feed the plants, the way my parents taught me. I don't need improved seed because enset is grown from suckers, and I have no irrigation — the rains in SNNP are enough for these plants.
